newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: PDZ, Diperdana rumoured in deal-dealers.
newsitem.headline: PDZ, Diperdana rumoured in deal-dealers.

text.p: Malaysian shipper Diperdana Corp Bhd's announcement that it is in talks for a possible acquisition of a stake in a company raised speculation of a deal with PDZ Holdings Bhd, dealers and analysts said on Friday.

Diperdana made the statement on Thursday when requesting a suspension in its stock effective November 1. It did not identify the company, but said it was a listed firm. Company officials were not available for further comment on Friday.

PDZ Holdings, also a shipper, on Friday requested a suspension in its stock trading pending a news announcement. A company official said PDZ would make an announcement by either Monday or Tuesday, but did not provide any details.

A report from HLG Securities on Friday said Diperdana was rumoured to have reached an agreement to buy 56.5 percent of PDZ from its major shareholders for about 335.6 million ringgit or 12 ringgit a share.
On Thursday, the stock of PDZ closed at 13.70 ringgit, while Diperdana finished at 20.80 ringgit.
HLG said in its research note that the rumoured deal is likely to be through a swap of three PDZ shares valued at 12 ringgit each for two Diperdana shares valued at 18 ringgit a share.
"There have been rumours that PDZ is going to be injected into Diperdana, but at the moment this is just a rumour," said a dealer at a local brokerage house.

The shipping industry is expected to consolidate as Malaysia builds up its transportation industry to reduce freight and shipping costs, which are a major contributor to its balance of payments deficit.
